text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!
Pegasus Maximum Shooter!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ngggggh, I won't lose, I won't lose!
I'm gonna be... DELICIOUSSSSS!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The race was a heated battle. In the end, Biko Pegasus seized a magnificent victory."

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text: Oho, we won! So this... is the physical prowess that moved you...

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
"It's truly magnificent!
I'd love to see her in person someday!"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Biko-chan was even more
amazing than usual today, though...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "I feel like this kind of power couldn't have come from Biko-chan alone."

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text: What? Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Even in movies, a hero grows stronger
the more formidable their opponent is..."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"What brought out Biko-chan's power today
was most likely..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I... won...
I defeated... evil... But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What is this tingling feeling all over my body...?
It's not... because I defeated the Grand Leader.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "I never thought I could get this fired up! Making it this far was all thanks to...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yes, surely—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, how dare you do that~!
Justice Biko~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't let myself just get stewed like this!
I will rise again, again and again~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do it again, Bono!
Definitely before this year ends! But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's rethink how we do the show!
I'm gonna go talk with Captain Onion for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: H-Huuh? Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Something mysterious
happened in that last race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What is this feeling!?
Whoaaa, this is completely different from before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing Hishi Akebono for the first time,
Biko Pegasus seemed to feel
a special kind of passion.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, racing against Bono was...
completely different from anything before! While running..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Iconic scenes of the two kept flashing through my mind!
Right, first off...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As the hero 'Justice Biko',
I'm gonna be just like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go! Justice Biko~
Hooray, hooray! Justice Bikooooo~â"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I debuted first, and Bono's cheers
kept me going strong! And then—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up, Bono! That's right, we're...
"Still just getting started—!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! You're right.
Dosukoi, push push!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (Then Bono will see me working hard and do her best too...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I'm finally standing on the same stage!
And—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to keep running like this forever!
I don't want to lose to anyone!’"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
While I was racing,
that feeling was all I had...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume who know everything about each other
and have shared everything together. Hishi Akebono is
truly someone special after all."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, in the Sprinters Stakes,
Bono and I were like the hero vs. the Great Leader.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still... I don't want to turn Bono into just the fall guy.
I want us both to get stronger and hype things up even more!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"To do that,
what kind of show should we do next?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Justice vs. Evil. That dynamic probably doesn't fit the two of them right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus out in front and Hishi Akebono giving chase. If we're looking for a better approach—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that way of talking...
You sound just like Captain Onion!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Do you have an idea!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I whisper "a certain something" into Biko Pegasus's ear. And with that—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ââ!! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're right! With that method...!
Trainer, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, what did you want to talk about? Oh, should I switch to villain mode instead?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Bonobonobono, I'm gonna beat you~☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...No! That's enough.
It's fine now, Bono.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I have something
I want you to take today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Biko-chan?
What did you want to give me?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And that is—this right here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's that...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono, playing the villain just doesn't suit you.
The Hishi Akebono I know is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Because she's an amazing Umamusume
who works just as hard as I do!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're being reborn from the Great Leader.
Yes, to fight passionately alongside me—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Into Carrotman No. 2!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Will you accept it? This mask.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want you to run with me!
So we can become idols that many children look up to!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan... To think you... felt that way about me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Being the villain was fun, but being a hero alongside my friends is way more buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll do it!
Carrotman No. 2!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright! Carotene charged!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: With this, you're a hero starting today!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Number 2! Next is the Mile CS. It's the final short-distance GⅠ of the year.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want you to show me the fastest running in history alongside me.
As my beloved hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, in the end, it's just you and me—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Double Justice!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, Biko-chan!
I'll do it. I'm so glad to be standing beside you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll run a race so bono
it'll surpass even Biko-chan No. 1!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, not so fast.
Sure, Bono is amazing,
but she's only second best at this Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The No. 1 is me,
Biko Pegasus!
Let's see who's faster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Biko-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, evil was reborn—and a new hero came to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus and Hishi Akebono. The mismatched duo head into the decisive Mile Championship as a double-hero team.
